summary: The figure shows a declining trend in both neonatal deaths (0–28 days) and post-neonatal under-five deaths (1–59 months) across all WHO regions from 2000 to 2021. The African Region consistently has the highest number of deaths, followed by the South-East Asia Region. Global under-five deaths and neonatal deaths have both decreased significantly over the period. The stacked areas represent the contribution of each WHO region to the total deaths, with the African and South-East Asia regions contributing the largest shares.
